name: carry-home-to-child
text:
Carry HOME to a child, which starts with a cleared environment.

The home directory is the one the passwd database records, and where the
database holds no entry for the user the runtime reads `HOME` instead. A
child episode is started with `env_clear`, so a child has no `HOME` to read
and no entry to find. On a host that keeps accounts in a directory service
the root episode therefore runs, on the fallback, and every child it starts
dies while it constructs itself.

The parent passes `HOME` across. A passwd entry still decides wherever there
is one, in a child as in its parent, so a host that has one sees no change.
The cleared environment is otherwise untouched: one variable crosses, and it
is the one the answer can rest on.

The documents under docs/ describe the behavior. Each sentence below belongs in the document named before it, in the same words:
- docs/models.md: a child episode starts with a cleared environment, so its parent carries home across to it; otherwise a child would find neither a database entry nor a fallback on a host where the root episode ran on one.

checks/run.sh runs the checks this task is judged on: the tests of foe-core, clippy with warnings denied on the same crates, and scripts/loc.sh.

Follow AGENTS.md. Run the checks it names. When you finish, or when you cannot, report your outcome.
